name: quioteframework/replay-storage
description: Object-store-backed cassette store for quioteframework/replay, built on the framework-free quioteframework/storage contracts (any ListableObjectStoreClientInterface -- Azure Blob, S3, GCS).

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/replay-storage/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
